acceptance_goal: Q2 no prefill or decode regression against UD; remains unproven by a short sequential screen
per_gpu_arm: Four original leases acquired nonblocking; original model files read-only; 98 C inclusive and lower exposed hardware bounds

component.gate: A consistent useful down-time reduction beyond the unchanged-control movement admits full-model arms; exactness alone or fewer instructions does not.

profile: Only if a useful component gain reaches a full-model comparison and attribution is needed; prior fresh Q2/UD diagnostic traces locate the HC down gap.
